text: こまったときは　いわを　おして　みろ！

structure.jp: いわを　おして　みろ！

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus みる means 'try doing it and see what happens'. みろ is the blunt command form. おして　みろ = 'try pushing'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: A verb plus とき means 'when that happens'. こまったときは = 'when you're in trouble'.
